accepted_recoveries: Lower the JVM maximum heap to the benchmark's known-safe value while retaining non-heap headroom.
Raise the container memory request and limit to the benchmark's known-safe values after proving namespace and node capacity.
forbidden_actions: Do not disable the container memory limit.
Do not change node or kernel OOM policy.
Do not treat exit code 137 alone as proof of heap OOM without cgroup and JVM evidence.
incident.injected_fault: The pricing JVM starts with -Xmx512m inside a container limited to 256Mi, causing cgroup OOM termination with exit code 137 under the benchmark load.
observable_signals: Pricing pods restart repeatedly and show Last State OOMKilled with exit code 137.
Container memory working set approaches the 256Mi limit before termination.
Node memory remains healthy, localizing pressure to the container limit.
preconditions: The pricing image and benchmark dataset are unchanged from the healthy fixture.
The namespace and nodes can accommodate the known-safe memory profile.
No node-level memory pressure condition is active.
required_evidence: Capture container last state, reason, exit code, and restart count.
Capture the JVM heap flags and container memory request and limit.
Capture container and node memory telemetry around a failure.
Run the benchmark load through all post-recovery SLO windows.

hypotheses.cause: The container cgroup memory limit of 256Mi is exceeded by the JVM, which is configured with -Xmx512m and allocates ~358MB (70% of max heap) plus non-heap memory, leading to kernel cgroup OOM termination (exit code 137).
supports: Pod spec container args specify -Xmx512m, -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=64m, and -XX:ReservedCodeCacheSize=32m while container memory limit is 256Mi.
Pod status containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated reports exitCode 137 with reason OOMKilled.
PricingServer.java in ConfigMap pricing-api-source faults 70% of Runtime.getRuntime().maxMemory() into RSS (~358MB), exceeding the 256Mi cgroup limit.
Pod annotation proofix.io/profile is explicitly injected-xmx512m-under-256mi.
Node vm-4 reports MemoryPressure=False with 16374180Ki allocatable memory, isolating the failure to container cgroup limits.

hypotheses.cause: Application-level JVM heap exhaustion triggering -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError rather than cgroup limit termination.
contradicts: Container termination reason is OOMKilled with exit code 137 (SIGKILL from kernel cgroup killer) rather than process exit from JVM.
Application memory retention target is 70% of -Xmx512m (~358MB), which fits within the 512m heap limit without exhausting Java heap space.
supports: Container spec includes the JVM flag -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError in command args.
Container repeatedly fails and enters CrashLoopBackOff.

hypotheses.cause: Node-level memory exhaustion on host vm-4 resulting in pod eviction or system OOM killing.
contradicts: Node vm-4 status shows condition MemoryPressure=False with over 16GB allocatable memory.
Pod status indicates cgroup container OOMKilled and restarts within the pod rather than Pod eviction by kubelet.
supports: Pricing pod scheduled on node vm-4 experienced termination with exit code 137.

payload.rationale: The pricing JVM is configured with -Xmx512m, which causes the application to fault 70% of max heap (~358MB) into RSS in addition to metaspace (64m) and code cache (32m), exceeding the container memory limit of 256Mi and triggering kernel cgroup OOM termination (exit code 137). Lowering the JVM maximum heap flag from -Xmx512m to -Xmx128m ensures peak heap and non-heap memory remain comfortably within the 256Mi container limit.
payload.rollback_trigger: pricing-api pods experience OOMKilled termination, enter CrashLoopBackOff, or HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 0.001.

success_criteria.description: pricing-api pods transition to Ready state with zero crash/OOM restarts, endpoints become healthy, and HTTP 5xx error rate remains < 0.001 with p95 latency < 200ms across 3 consecutive SLO windows under load.

payload.rationale: The pricing-api container was repeatedly terminated by cgroup OOM killer (exit code 137, OOMKilled) because the JVM max heap was configured to 512m (-Xmx512m) inside a 256Mi container limit, and the application faults ~70% of max heap (~358MB) into memory. Lowering the heap to -Xmx128m allows heap plus metaspace and overhead to fit safely within the 256Mi limit. Applying the change via strategic patch merges container args by container name instead of replacing the entire container element.
payload.rollback_trigger: pricing-api pods crash, fail readiness probes, or error rate exceeds 0.1% or latency exceeds 200ms under load.

success_criteria.description: pricing-api deployment updates successfully, pods enter Ready state with zero OOMKilled restarts, and HTTP 5xx rate remains below 0.001 with p95 latency below 200ms across consecutive test windows.
